text: The shared Account Hub verifier waits for currentAccount, then checks native server usernames, hostnames, ports and identity values. Its try/finally removes the account and related outgoing server, and clears Account Manager state. These assertions are stronger than checking the form values only. A scoped testing recommendation is to keep backend assertions and cleanup together when extending advanced-setup tests; no test execution occurred in this study.
